Name: Essential Furniture
Author: LuanArroz
Description:
[size=6][font=Verdana][color=#f4f4f4]Features[/color][/font]
[/size]
- Over 600 furniture items have been added to the vanilla catalog, including variations of original and new furniture pieces
- Tables, chairs, benches, stools, wardrobes. With 10 variations each
- Couch in all sizes with 7 different colors to choose from
- Modular Table For all End Tables in the game
- 12 New windows- 6 New decorative doorsAnd more!
